risk_target: R1 (Kohn-Luttinger hyperfine uncertainty & R331 49.05% ENDOR error)
question: Can a first-principles 6-valley central-cell Kohn-Luttinger theory (VOKL-6: coupled 6-valley anisotropic effective-mass + Ning-Sah/Pantelides-Sah screened central-cell potential calibrated exclusively to 31P spectral invariants A1=-45.59 meV, T2-A1=11.70 meV, E-A1=13.01 meV, A_P(0)=117.53 MHz, convolved with full 3D k-space Cohen-Bergstresser 145-PW EPM conduction-band Bloch wavepackets and 3D Fermi-contact + dipolar tensor) reduce the out-of-sample 29Si ENDOR shell discrepancy (specifically R331 legacy KL 49.05% error) without fitting any 29Si shell, and how does it shift Mode B epitaxial bath K=8 selection yield and the Exp126 6.89 kHz DDRF gap risk across f in {0.5%, 1.0%, 2.0%} (N_cell=400)?

calibration_invariants_31P_only.source: Ramdas & Rodriguez (1981), Mayur et al. PRB 48, 10893 (1993), Feher PR 114, 1219 (1959)

out_of_sample_29Si_benchmarks.source: Audited Exp56/60/69/75 benchmark from Hale & Mieher PR 184, 739 (1969), Overhof & Gerstmann PRL 92, 087602 (2004), Ma et al. Commun. Phys. 5, 165 (2022) Fig. 3

predictions.description: Bare anisotropic EMT reproduces E_EMT = -31.27 +/- 0.25 meV; calibrated VOKL-6 (zero 29Si fitting) reproduces E(1s A1)=-45.59 +/- 0.05 meV, Delta_VO(T2-A1)=11.70 +/- 0.05 meV, Delta_VO(E-A1)=13.01 +/- 0.05 meV, A_P(0)=117.53 +/- 0.50 MHz with physical central-cell core radius 0.05 <= r_c <= 0.35 nm.

Exact Td 6-valley multiplet structure (1x A1, 3x T2 degenerate within 1e-6 meV, 2x E degenerate within 1e-6 meV), wavefunction normalization |norm - 1| <= 1e-8, and traceless 3D dipolar tensor max |Tr(T_dip)| < 1e-10 Hz across all 45,214 sites.
Out-of-sample VOKL-6 (calibrated only to 31P spectral invariants) reduces the (3,3,1) ENDOR shell relative error strictly below legacy KL (49.05%) to <= 30.0%.

Across the 4 audited benchmark shells {(1,1,1), (3,3,1), (2,2,0), (1,1,-3)}, out-of-sample VOKL-6 achieves strictly lower log10-ratio RMS error than legacy KL (0.5625) AND keeps (1,1,1) relative error <= 35.0%.
Portable Mode B engine reproduces Exp59/62 legacy KL yields bit-for-bit on seed59 (N=100): f=0.5% -> 26/100, f=1.0% -> 51/100, f=2.0% -> 69/100.

At N_cell=400 per abundance, VOKL-6 Mode B K=8 yield at f=1.0% remains >= 0.40, and |Y_VOKL6(f) - Y_KL(f)| <= 0.15 across f in {0.5%, 1.0%, 2.0%}, collapsing Risk R1's legacy Exp60 +43 pp yield uncertainty.

Across certified K=8 registers at f=1.0% (N_cell=400), VOKL-6 median min_transition_gap_Hz remains >= 6.893 kHz (Exp126 F1 q3 DDRF threshold) and the fraction of registers below 6.893 kHz is explicitly bounded (<= 50%).

success_rule: All 7 pre-registered criteria CE1..CE7 pass; any failure is reported transparently with quantitative root-cause ablation (envelope contraction vs k-space Bloch wavepacket vs residual atomistic/core-polarization/d-orbital physics).
